description: Manages FlashFusion's community intelligence and audience engagement using HubSpot (MCP connected), Notion (MCP connected), and LinkedIn (manual surface — no MCP). Common Room is NOT connected; this skill works without it and flags its absence explicitly. Surfaces who is engaging with FlashFusion content, identifies high-intent community members, and guides community-building decisions for the newsletter audience and LinkedIn following. Activates when the user mentions: community, audience engagement, who's engaging with my content, community building, newsletter audience, community intelligence, GTM community, who should I reach out to from my audience, Common Room (will surface NOT_CONNECTED status), LinkedIn engagement signals, warm prospect identification, or any request to understand or act on who is engaging with FlashFusion.
